headline: License applications for Marino's transfer, El Jalisco Mexican Grill, Hale Street Tavern manager change, and one-day licenses.
summary: The agenda lists three applications to transfer a license or change a manager for alcohol sales. It also lists four one-day license applications and other new business.
items: Application for transfer of license from AM Restaurant Group, LLC dba Marino's to Pressed Café Beverly dba Pressed Café, Jessica Bassett, manager, for the sale of all alcoholic beverages at 900 Cummings Center, Suite 100-U, Beverly.
Application for transfer of license to Jalisco Mexican, Inc. dba El Jalisco Mexican Grill, Miguel A. Flores, manager, for the sale of wine, malt beverages and cordials at 150 Cabot Street, Beverly.
Application for change of manager from Flour N Water Corp. dba Hale Street Tavern and Oyster Bar, Joseph Nickerson, manager, for the sale of all alcoholic beverages at 717 Hale Street, Beverly.

One-day license applications: T. Mills (11/6 at Cove Community Ct); S. Berchoff (11/14 at Cove Community Ctr); L. Hatch (11/26 at Cove Community Ctr); Endicott (11/18 at School of Nursing). Any additional applications received before 3:00 pm on 11/5/2026 may also be considered.
location: Community Room, Beverly Police Department, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly
